Demonic Ammo.Lore: A more vile and destructive revision of the standard transmutable matter, made by the witches who betrayed their kind and work with the Church for untold rewards.

Standard Ammo.Description: Works with most weapons except Demonic ones.
Standard Ammo.Lore: Transmutable matter that reacts to designs hidden in a weapon's magic.

Broken Mirror.Lore: A vile item that twists the reflection to be that of a corpse. Lowers confidence while strengthening the resolve of enemies.

Demonic Ammo Pack.Lore: A bag of proto-ammo in quantities carefully measured not to affect the owner's sanity.

Drop of Liquid Witchfire.Description: An instant Focus due to a powerful boost of Stamina.
Drop of Liquid Witchfire.Lore: Seeing how addicted and careless it made the preyers, the Workshop stopped conjuring it decades ago.

Euphoria of the Dying.Lore: Witchfire dust injected then immediately extracted from a Flagellant during the blissful moment right before death.

Foul Stimulant.Description: Improves witchfire gains during an expedition but weakens Health and Stamina. Death leaves no corpse.
Foul Stimulant.Lore: Crucial to the creation of preyers, as it triggers clinical death in mortals. Slows down the heart, improving metanoia.

Four-leaf Clover.Description: Lowers the [[Calamity]] threat by one level.
Four-leaf Clover.Lore: A delicate plant said to be kissed by a witch of natural beauty. Boosts confidence while weakening the will of adversaries.

Healing Elixir.Lore: An elixir made of witchfire-infused Angelica herb. Hidden in a capsule that preyers can easily crush.
Healing Elixir.Trivia: Amount carried scales with Ascension level.

Herbalist's Brew.Lore: A hallucinogen used by the Vestals to seduce their targets. Witchfire in the blood neutralizes the potion but opens the senses to its ingredients.

King's Bell.Lore: Used by heralds of the king of Irongate to announce his return. A warning for all carriages and carts to promptly give way or face the king's wrath.

Philosopher's Stone.Lore: A forgotten byproduct of the Workshop's search for the elixir of life. Filled with witchfire-enhanced red sulfur.

Placebo Pill.Description: Fakes the Ascension, tricking any witch into reorganizing her defenses. Rearranges the Enemy Camps on all Maps.
Placebo Pill.Lore: A worthless tablet made useful only by conditioning new preyers to react to its peculiar taste.

Portal Flame.Description: Re-activates the entry portal for a limited time.
Portal Flame.Lore: A frozen flame of the Vestal fire, able to reignite the wonders offered by the crossing of ley lines.

Standard Ammo Pack.Lore: A bag of proto-ammo in quantities carefully measured not to affect the owner's flesh.

Treasure Hunter's Prism.Description: Marks [[Supply Chests|chests]] and [[Treasures]] on the main map and mini-map.
Treasure Hunter's Prism.Lore: An old Workshop's invention, later replaced by the rosary of magpie eyes. Both ultimately banned by the Pope for their unorthodox use by the more inquisitive preyers.

Witchfire Guard.Description: No witchfire lost on death but no remains left behind.
Witchfire Guard.Lore: A weak hex made more efficient by using the untouched skin of a Flagellant for the protection sigil.

Siren's Shell.Description: A shell whose call few can resist.
Siren's Shell.Lore: An artifact considered mythical even by the most superstitious sailors, capable of delivering its call to worlds beyond.
Siren's Shell.Trivia: Summons the Familiar of the [[Scarlet Coast]]

Giant Witchfire Block.Description: A large piece of crystallized witchfire. Can be vaporized into [[volatile witchfire]].
Giant Witchfire Block.Lore: When the volatile witchfire oversaturates the air, it solidifies into crystals. Most of these crystals are stable enough to be moved to different locations.
Giant Witchfire Block.Trivia: Gives 4000-8000 volatile witchfire upon use. Scales with Metanoia

Large Witchfire Cluster.Description: A cluster of crystallized witchfire. Can be vaporized into [[volatile witchfire]].
Large Witchfire Cluster.Lore: When the volatile witchfire oversaturates the air, it solidifies into crystals. Most of these crystals are stable enough to be moved to different locations.
Large Witchfire Cluster.Trivia: Gives 2000 volatile witchfire upon use. Scales with Metanoia

Medium Witchfire Chunk.Description: A chunk of crystallized witchfire. Can be vaporized into [[volatile witchfire]].
Medium Witchfire Chunk.Lore: When the volatile witchfire oversaturates the air, it solidifies into crystals. Most of these crystals are stable enough to be moved to different locations.
Medium Witchfire Chunk.Trivia: Gives 1000 volatile witchfire upon use. Scales with Metanoia

Small Witchfire Splinter.Description: A splinter of crystallized witchfire. Can be vaporized into [[volatile witchfire]].
Small Witchfire Splinter.Lore: When the volatile witchfire oversaturates the air, it solidifies into crystals. Most of these crystals are stable enough to be moved to different locations.
Small Witchfire Splinter.Trivia: Gives 400 volatile witchfire upon use. Scales with Metanoia

Tiny Witchfire Shard.Description: A shard of crystallized witchfire. Can be vaporized into [[volatile witchfire]].
Tiny Witchfire Shard.Lore: When the volatile witchfire oversaturates the air, it solidifies into crystals. Most of these crystals are stable enough to be moved to different locations.
Tiny Witchfire Shard.Trivia: Gives 200 volatile witchfire upon use. Scales with Metanoia

Gold.Description: Earned from selling found treasure. An incentive for the Vatican researchers to work extra hours.
Gold.Lore: God's glory enchanted into matter, a sun's warmth turned solid.

Preyer Echo.Description: A small ball of witchfire mist.
Preyer Echo.Lore: A faint trace of magical activity, visible only to the Vestal Flame. It reveals the presence of a preyer, but not their identity.

Volatile Witchfire.Description: A corrupt Ether, the source of witch magic.
Volatile Witchfire.Lore: Ether, the fifth element, manifested. A conduit of witchcraft. Known to witches and preyers, abominations created with its magic. None truly understand it.

White Raven Feather.Description: With proper rituals, a wish written with a white raven's feather comes true. Used to manifest [[Arcana]].
White Raven Feather.Lore: A powerful witch loved a folk tale and turned it into reality. A reality the feathers can alter, as long as she lives.
White Raven Feather.Trivia: Used to reveal, unlock or reroll Arcana

Charged Shadow Orb.Description: Brims with power to hasten the unveiling of hidden Mysteria.
Charged Shadow Orb.Lore: An old, experimental device crafted by Vatican scholars. Records the ebb and flow of battle.
Charged Shadow Orb.Trivia: Earned upon completion of a Shadow Orb's quest.

Second Mysterium Incantation.Description: A eldritch incantation that allows the conjurer to understand the [[Incantation|Second Mysterium]] of enchanted items.
Second Mysterium Incantation.Lore: Created in the forbidden part of the Workshop, these pages are barely understood by even the wisest of Gnostics.

Third Mysterium Incantation.Description: An eldritch incantation that allows the conjurer to understand the [[Incantation|Third Mysterium]] of enchanted items.
Third Mysterium Incantation.Lore: Created in the forbidden part of the Workshop, these pages are barely understood by even the wisest of Gnostics.

Compendium Diabolicum Page I.Description: A page from an old grimoire.
Compendium Diabolicum Page I.Lore: When pressed beyond their limit, the vile creatures falter, as if their senses have fled them. In that moment their witchfire wanes, leaving them exposed and doubly vulnerable.

Herbalist's Note I.Lore: Brothers, keep vigil for Angelica during your penance travels. Seek out the thickest growth and faintest shadows. Gather more if you wish it used for something beyond a mere healing draught.

Island of the Damned Chart.Description: Navigation charts are used to safely traverse ley lines. This one details a route to a nearby island with a giant tower.
Island of the Damned Chart.Lore: An older chart, possibly created long before the arrival of the Order of the Broken Mirror's flotilla. It is a curious case, as Vatican archives contain no record of any preyers ever charting these territories.

Monk's Note I.Lore: The dreams command me, and I obey. In the wall, I unearthed a vile, green glow-alive, watching. The wispers urge me to follow. I won't... but the light waits.

Ornate Key.Description: Seems to fit a unique lock.
Ornate Key.Lore: When the king of Irongate turned the casemate into a torture chamber, he demanded a secret exit, and a single key.
Ornate Key.Trivia: Used for the Cave Gate on [[Irongate Castle]]

Preyer's Note I.Description: A note signed with the preyer's sigil.
Preyer's Note I.Lore: Cain has not returned, as I feared. I warned him of his unreadiness... I have sealed the passage and ensured its protection. Join me at the Hermitorium.

Preyer's Note II.Description: A note signed with the preyer's sigil.
Preyer's Note II.Lore: If this note is in your hands, it means we have fallen. Mayhap we have at least diminished her strength. Ignite the flame and call us forth, so that our work toward redemption may yet continue.

Scarlet Coast Chart.Description: Navigation charts are used to safely traverse ley lines. This one details a route to a nearby island with a giant tower.
Scarlet Coast Chart.Lore: The more skilled the preyer in ley line reading, the lower the chance of failure. Yet, danger still persists, leading for the preference for using slaves, criminals and other lost souls as wayfinders.

Strange Coin.Description: A dead guard by the castle's side gate might be interested in such a beauty. Used to enter the Castle on [[Irongate Castle]].
Strange Coin.Lore: The coin must be old but, like many things in the world of the witch, doesn't seem to have aged.
